text.hi: किताब का पहला सवाल: अपनी किसी यात्रा के बारे में लिखो। सवालों के जवाब देते जाओ, पैराग्राफ़ बन जाएगा: कब और कहाँ गए? कौन साथ था? क्या देखा?
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka pehla sawaal: apni kisi yaatra ke baare mein likho. Sawaalon ke jawab dete jaao, paragraph ban jaayega: kab aur kahan gaye? Kaun saath tha? Kya dekha?
text.en: The book's first task: write about a journey. Answer the questions one by one and you have a paragraph: when and where did you go? Who was with you? What did you see?

prompt.hi: कब और कहाँ गए: पिछली गर्मियों में मैं उज्जैन गया/गई।
prompt.hinglish: Kab aur kahan gaye: pichhli garmiyon mein main Ujjain gaya/gayi.
prompt.en: Say when and where you went (Ujjain, last summer).

steps.answer: Last summer I went to Ujjain by train.

meaning.hi: पिछली गर्मियों में मैं ट्रेन से उज्जैन गया/गई।
meaning.hinglish: Pichhli garmiyon mein main train se Ujjain gaya/gayi.

prompt.hi: तैयारी: हमने एक हफ़्ता पहले टिकट बुक किए।
prompt.hinglish: Taiyaari: humne ek hafta pehle ticket book kiye.
prompt.en: Say how you planned the journey.

steps.answer: We booked our tickets a week before.

meaning.hi: हमने एक हफ़्ता पहले टिकट बुक किए।
meaning.hinglish: Humne ek hafta pehle ticket book kiye.

prompt.hi: कौन साथ था: मेरे मम्मी-पापा और बहन साथ थे।
prompt.hinglish: Kaun saath tha: mere mummy-papa aur behen saath the.

steps.answer: My parents and my sister went with me.

meaning.hi: मेरे मम्मी-पापा और बहन मेरे साथ गए।
meaning.hinglish: Mere mummy-papa aur behen mere saath gaye.

text.hi: किताब का दूसरा सवाल: प्रिंसिपल को चार दिन की छुट्टी की अर्ज़ी। परीक्षा में यह ढाँचा याद रखो: To, The Principal, (School name). Subject: Application for four days' leave. Sir/Madam, I am a student of class VII. I have to go out of station with my family. So I request you to grant me leave for four days. Thanking you. Yours obediently, (Your name), Class VII.
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka doosra sawaal: principal ko chaar din ki chhutti ki arzi. Pariksha mein yeh dhaancha yaad rakho: To, The Principal, (School name). Subject: Application for four days' leave. Sir/Madam, I am a student of class VII. I have to go out of station with my family. So I request you to grant me leave for four days. Thanking you. Yours obediently, (Your name), Class VII.
text.en: The book's second task: a leave application to the principal. Remember this format for the exam: To, The Principal, (School name). Subject: Application for four days' leave. Sir/Madam, I am a student of class VII. I have to go out of station with my family. So I request you to grant me leave for four days. Thanking you. Yours obediently, (Your name), Class VII.

prompt.hi: अर्ज़ी की मुख्य लाइन: कृपया मुझे चार दिन की छुट्टी दें।
prompt.hinglish: Arzi ki mukhya line: kripya mujhe chaar din ki chhutti dein.
prompt.en: The main line of the application: ask for four days' leave.

steps.answer: I request you to grant me leave for four days.

meaning.hi: कृपया मुझे चार दिन की छुट्टी देने की कृपा करें।
meaning.hinglish: Kripya mujhe chaar din ki chhutti dene ki kripa karein.

steps.question: How does a leave application to the principal end?

questionMeaning.hi: प्रिंसिपल को अर्ज़ी कैसे ख़त्म होती है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Principal ko arzi kaise khatm hoti hai?

steps.question: What do we write first in a leave application?

questionMeaning.hi: छुट्टी की अर्ज़ी में सबसे पहले क्या लिखते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Chhutti ki arzi mein sabse pehle kya likhte hain?
